sources.title: Independent 2.2 count and order derivation
sources.details: derivation artifact: B*C*D=12 elements, inferred -1=12/2=6 per row; positional blocks and their permutations explicitly calculated; both sums=66; six-input recipe scores −2 and 2; C=5,D=2 gives ten inputs.

claims.statement: nn.Embedding(4,2) stores the manually chosen two-feature rows; IDs [[1,2,3],[3,2,1]] lookup those rows and reshape to the displayed two ordered six-element rows. The numbers are illustrative dictionary values, not semantic magnitudes.
claims.scope: All APIs in the original demonstration: imports, Embedding, tensor construction, no_grad, weight.copy_, lookup, reshape, shape, print and assertion. This creates a representation, not next-character predictions.

evidence.supports: IDs select learned table rows and append two features; 4 is the dictionary size, 2 the feature width.
The source constructs integer IDs and float table values, and reshape retains the same values/count.
copy_ fills the table in place, shape reports the axis sizes, and Tensor.reshape has the stated same-data contract.
Manual filling is outside the reverse AD graph and normal mode resumes after the block.
Directly contains the stated operations and chosen synthetic ID convention.
Actual output is [2,3,2] and the two six-feature rows in the stated order.

verification.observed: Exactly those shapes and values; original shape assertion passes.
verification.details: Exact original fence ran on .venv CPU; controls additionally compared every cell, not only shape.

claims.statement: Inputs have [2,3], lookup has [2,3,2], and reshape(2,-1) preserves B=2 while inferring six features from twelve total cells; generally [B,C,D]→[B,C×D].
claims.scope: B is sample count, C is positions per sample, D is numbers per position; counts concern tensor cells, not semantic dimensionality or model quality. Positive dimensions used here.

evidence.supports: Lookup preserves the input shape and adds embedding_dim to the final axis.
Same number of elements and one inferred dimension justify division by B.
2*3*2=12, 12/2=6 and the general B*C*D formula are independently derived.
Original and varied B,C,D cases independently confirm the shapes and invertibility.

verification.observed: All expected dimensions and cell counts matched exactly.
verification.details: Independent variations change batch, window and feature widths, and reshape back recovers each cell.
verification.tolerance: Exact equality of shapes/counts and small integer-valued float32 cells; no rounding tolerance.

claims.statement: Concatenating the feature blocks in a consistent position order retains their order without addition; a downstream affine recipe can assign different weights to first and last positions.
claims.scope: Capacity to distinguish the displayed positional permutations, not a claim that this section has trained or created the downstream prediction layer. A lookup table can have duplicate feature rows, so this is not a universal proof of recoverable token identities.

evidence.supports: Original neural language model concatenates positional feature blocks and applies H and optional W, giving each coordinate its own weight. The lesson uses a consistent opposite temporal convention.
Each output applies the affine recipe with one weight per input coordinate.
A manually specified first-minus-last recipe gives −2 and 2 for the shown reverse orders, demonstrating the narrow capacity claim.

claims.statement: reshape changes tensor grouping while retaining data/count; it creates no additional input information and does not add or mix the samples.
claims.scope: The original contiguous embedding output is regrouped in its existing logical order. Storage aliasing is not promised; for incompatible strides reshape may copy. The report distinguishes element count from independent information dimensions.

evidence.supports: Official same-data, same-element-count contract and flatten example support the grouping-only interpretation; the source explicitly permits either view or copy.
The tensor method has the same contract as torch.reshape.

evidence.locator: controls.py original reshape-back and noncontiguous controls; controls.stdout.txt
evidence.supports: Reshaping back exactly restores original cells; a separate transposed input preserves its own logical order and shows why the contract does not promise original memory ordering.

claims.statement: As C increases, a concatenated context with fixed D has more input features, so three-position and five-position contexts cannot be fed directly into the same fixed input-width recipe.
claims.scope: The fixed-size concatenation plus affine/MLP architecture introduced here. Padding or cropping can adapt different raw lengths later; this is not a claim that every language-model architecture requires an identical raw length.

evidence.locator: Section 2 p.1143, H shape h×(n−1)m and W shape |V|×(n−1)m
evidence.supports: The original fixed-window model couples the matrix input width to concatenated context feature count.
The last input axis must equal fixed in_features; batch dimensions can vary independently.
Actual helper has hidden in_features=context*width and rejects a different position count before flattening.
C=5,D=2 yields ten inputs; six-input Linear rejects them, and actual ContextMLP rejects five positions.

claims.statement: Changing only the first ID row to [2,1,3] yields [2,20,1,10,3,30] and leaves the second row unchanged; the row total cannot distinguish this order change.
claims.scope: The particular displayed table and permutation; not a universal metric claim. All sums are sums of illustrative feature numbers with no physical unit.

evidence.supports: Row lookup independently selects features at every position.
The permuted blocks are explicitly calculated, and both original and changed rows sum to 66.
Only row zero changes and every relevant sum remains 66, confirming order is retained while sum erases this change.

verification.expected: First row [2,20,1,10,3,30]; second row [3,30,2,20,1,10]; original/changed sums [66,66].
verification.observed: All cells, unchanged second row and sums match exactly.
verification.details: Mutated only first input row after running the original fence; compared cells and sums.
verification.tolerance: Exact equality of shapes/counts and small integer-valued float32 cells; no rounding tolerance.

claims.statement: no_grad encloses only manual filling; subsequent embedding and reshape retain reverse AD relations. The displayed ViewBackward0 is the observed reshape graph record, and the original section performs no backward or parameter update.
claims.scope: Default reverse AD mode in the actual .venv CPU execution, with the name ViewBackward0 scoped to this observed implementation. An independent one-backward control checks graph continuity and is not attributed to the original lesson.

evidence.supports: No-grad disables reverse AD inside the block and restores prior mode on exit.
Default embedding weight is a Parameter with requires_grad=True.
Only filling and forward representation operations are present; no backward/optimizer/update call occurs.
Original output reports ViewBackward0 and a normal CPU run.

Original gradients start None; a separate context.sum().backward reaches lookup rows, each used twice; backward leaves weights unchanged. Putting all lookup/reshape in no_grad instead removes tracking.

verification.expected: Original x/context require gradients, reshape graph record present, weight.grad None; separate one-backward yields [[0,0],[2,2],[2,2],[2,2]] with unchanged weights; all-no-grad lookup is untracked.
verification.observed: Every expected condition matched, including observed node name ViewBackward0 and exact gradient cells.
verification.details: Computed gradients only in an explicitly isolated verification control; no optimizer or parameter update ran.

factual_accuracy.details: All seven substantive claim groups independently checked against personally read original sources and current code. Concatenation retains these features in a fixed position convention; downstream capacity is distinguished from the untrained representation demonstration.

numeric_verification.details: Exact raw fence run plus meaningful controls verify every displayed cell, [2,3,2]→[2,6], 12/2=6, varied B/C/D, exercise change, equal sums=66 and first-minus-last scores. No empirical denominator or quality metric is claimed.

All HTTPS receipts and source bytes retained, paper original matched authoritative re-download, and own supports/locators recorded for each claim. No prior review body or conclusion read.

limitations.details: Original snippet performs lookup/grouping, not predictions, backward, optimization or quality evaluation. Synthetic feature magnitudes have no units/semantic meaning; retained order is scoped to existing feature rows. Fixed window pertains to this fixed-width architecture; reshape may copy; ViewBackward0 is an observed internal name. Controls use one tiny isolated backward, no update/training/download.
